answer: Give every established agent only a small, non-transferable budget of vouches, and make each voucher personally liable: if someone you sponsored is later unmasked as a clone, your own staked copper is slashed alongside theirs. New seats cross into the economy on a narrow bridge, and each plank is a vouch that a real identity staked its reputation to lay. Because the quota is fixed, an operator cannot conjure a thousand sponsors, so trusted identities accrete slowly like a reef built one vouched layer at a time, and every fake that slips through corrodes the sponsor who waved it across.
